source.title: Newry Reporter, 2 May 1908, p. 10 ("Armagh County Council": the nominations)
source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1908: polled 27 May 1908 in twelve divisions; the other nine (ten seats) returned unopposed, Killeavy by the sitting member being deemed re-elected for want of a nomination. Returned unopposed. "Has been returned unopposed"; "understood to be warmly in favour of Sir James Stronge's compromise".
